summary: Adds a way for a softwire client using DHCPv4 over DHCPv6 (RFC 7341) to tell the network which IPv6 address it will use as the source of its IPv4-in-IPv6 tunnel. Operators need this for some softwire mechanisms, such as those in RFC 7596 and RFC 7597. It is a standards-track document.

eli5.summary: To deliver old-style mail through a new kind of postal system, the post office needs to know your return address on the new system. This document lets your device tell the network that address.

questions: ipv4 over ipv6 tunnel source address dhcp
